name: Microsoft Copilot
summary: Microsoft Copilot includes the Study and Learn Agent for scaffolded study, practice activities and work with learner-provided materials.

value: PDF and URLs as learner-provided materials

value.notes: Study and Learn included with Microsoft 365 Education A1, A3 and A5; other Copilot entitlements vary.

models: Microsoft AI models; exact model/version not stated in Study and Learn documentation reviewed
value.notes: No (Microsoft 365 Education tenant prompts, responses and shared materials not used to train foundation models)

answers.question: Trains AI models on customer data
answers.value: No (Microsoft 365 Education tenant prompts, responses and shared materials not used to train foundation models)
answers.note: M365 commitments apply; exact underlying model/version not disclosed in Study and Learn docs.

answers.question: How long prompts and chats are kept
answers.value: Same retention and compliance policies as Microsoft 365 service; organisation controls retention
answers.note: No separate Study and Learn database; tenant controls apply.

answers.question: AI models used
answers.value: Microsoft AI models; exact model/version not stated in Study and Learn documentation reviewed
answers.note: M365 commitments apply; exact underlying model/version not disclosed in Study and Learn docs.

answers.question: Minimum learner age
answers.note: Available to education users aged 13+; K–12 admins set age and consent controls.

answers.question: Staff can review AI output before learners see it
Staff can set limits on the AI
answers.note: Teachers do not see student conversations unless shared; admins may use retention/eDiscovery controls.

answers.question: Staff can see learner conversations
answers.value: No separate Study and Learn database; Microsoft 365 retention, audit and eDiscovery policies apply. Teachers do not ordinarily see private study conversations.
answers.note: Teachers do not see student conversations unless shared; admins may use retention/eDiscovery controls.

answers.question: How it responds to learners
answers.value: Guides rather than gives answers (Study and Learn); asks questions and gives hints before answers; writing coach does not write essays
answers.note: Designed to ask questions, provide hints, scaffold and coach rather than write student essays.

answers.question: Answers from your own course content
answers.note: Supports Word, PowerPoint, PDF, URLs and Copilot Pages; citations are included.

answers.question: Shows its sources
answers.note: Supports Word, PowerPoint, PDF, URLs and Copilot Pages; citations are included.

answers.question: Who owns what the AI produces

researchTasks: Confirm age and policy requirements for other Copilot experiences separately; Study and Learn Agent documented at 13+; confirm exact model/version and output ownership.
Ask vendor (Who processes the data): Please provide the current list of subprocessors and applicable Australian data residency commitments.
Ask vendor (Staff can review AI output before learners see it): Can institutions configure teacher access to Study and Learn conversations, and what audit/eDiscovery controls are available?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns generated courses, questions, feedback, assessments and learner outputs? What licence does your company retain?

Researcher note (learnerOversight), not shown until sourced: Teachers do not see student conversations or practice results unless student shares them; administrators can use applicable M365 compliance/eDiscovery controls.
Researcher note (learnerOversight), not shown until sourced: Age value is a minimum eligibility signal only; check school/parent consent and local jurisdictional requirements.

Researcher note (outputOwnership), not shown until sourced: Microsoft says prompts and outputs are not used to train foundation models; Study and Learn is available to eligible education users aged 13+.
